# Quality Gates & Definition of Done

_Applies when: finishing any change — the single, stack-neutral DoD; nothing ships until it passes._

The one Definition of Done every stack shares. Stack overlays layer on top and never restate this
(web: `31-quality-web.md`). Baseline code standards live in `00-core.md`.

## Fail loud — never silently pass

- **Every gate has a precondition; if it is missing, the gate goes RED or LOUD — never green.** Green
  without its precondition manufactures justified trust with no backing; gates fail **closed**.
- **A gate that cannot state its profile is not one:** its **reach** as a self-emitted number (0
  scanned things is RED; a directory excluded from `include`/ignores/test globs owes a RED-verified
  substitute), a canary mutating the **gate**, not the fixture (own shipped config, exact rule id +
  severity), a **positive control** on that same config (rejecting is not letting through), and the
  **mode** — coverage is blind under a foreign resolver, runner or environment (`skill:verify`).
- Verified: a **stale index** claiming "no changes detected" over 647 files; a **lint rule** skipping
  unresolvable imports, green at `error`; a **probe exiting 0 on empty output**; a CI leg red on
  locale and 8.3 short names while every local gate was green. Each failed open.
- **Exit codes lie** — `gitnexus status` exits 0 on a never-indexed repo, so the obvious
  `status || block` hook never fires. Verify what a gate **emits**, not that it ran.

## Gate evidence — a claim is not a result

- **"Gate X ran, all green" is unfalsifiable — never accept it** from an agent, a subagent report, or
  yourself. Evidence is **a number the gate itself emitted that cannot be produced without running
  it**: `lint: 1370 files, 0 errors`; `index @ <sha> == HEAD`; `47 tests passed`.
- Same bar for **reports** and **decisions**, in **both** directions — the finding that comes OUT of a
  check included: a claim without file:line / output / sha is a hypothesis, a void reference is
  unfounded (a greenlight is not an eval — re-evaluate, don't build the ticket), "confirmed" is a
  label. And **sourced is not current**: name the state you read (sha/date), a newer commit voids it,
  local green is no evidence for the CI runner.

## Full green gate — before every commit

- `lint`, `typecheck` (strict), the **full test suite** and `build` all pass — not a smoke test; strict
  TS: no `any`, `@ts-ignore`, non-null hacks, deleted tests or silent TODOs, each only if justified.

## Verify the change actually works (mandatory)

- Green tests are not proof. **Drive the changed flow end-to-end via the `verify` skill.**
- **Visual defers, data never (ADR-0022).** Visual verification may defer to manual QA — but only with
  a note of **who runs it and when**; a bare "deferred" is a silent skip. **A schema, contract or
  serialization change ALWAYS has an automatable round-trip surface — the golden test is required even
  when the visual surface defers.** Incident and pattern: `skill:contract-golden-test`.
- **Exempt** only when the diff has no runtime surface (tests-only, docs-only); product source always
  has one. Noticing a contract touch is itself a step — run `25-orchestration`'s grep "Review check".

## Regression tests — verified RED, not assumed

- **A regression test must fail against the broken implementation** — build the mutation in, watch it
  fail, take it back out. Proving a mechanism **works** is not proving it **stops**; only a count does
  — and a name is not an assertion ("…without hello ping-pong" never counted messages).
- **Type-only tests are worthless where tests are excluded from typecheck**: `import type` is
  transpiled away — the test asserts its own literals and stays green after the field is deleted. Wire
  shapes need a **runtime or golden test** against the module source, keyed by name, never by position
  (`skill:contract-golden-test`).

## Definition of done

- Acceptance criteria met, the changed surface verified (above), exported functions/components/types
  carrying JSDoc (param/return); CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` updated, ADR added if architecture changed,
  story moved to `done/`, memory written for the task (`23-memory-discipline`).

## Code-intelligence safety (when a graph index is available)

- Run impact / blast-radius analysis before editing or renaming a symbol; warn on HIGH/CRITICAL first.
  Rename through the call graph, never blind find-and-replace. Doc/markdown-only edits are exempt.
- The index must be **fresh AND about THIS worktree** — a foreign checkout's is a missing precondition:
  declare source evidence as a **substitute**, never "gate green", and on real rebuild risk (renames,
  signature changes) opt into fail-closed instead (`skill:gitnexus-guide`, "Worktrees").
